text: きじも　なかずば　うたれまいに　って　ことか
note: This is a Japanese proverb, 雉も鳴かずば撃たれまい: the pheasant would not have been shot had it kept quiet, said of someone who brings trouble on themselves by speaking up. The English game dropped it for "I had to bug you!".
claim: 雉も鳴かずば撃たれまい is a Japanese proverb meaning that one invites trouble by speaking unnecessarily.

check.quote: よけいなことを言わなければ、災難に会わずにすんだ、という意味です。
